frage: How many CI checks block a merge into main?
regel: Decision of 2026-06-01: five required checks (unit-tests, lint, build, security-scan, license-check) block a merge into main.
ort: ci/required-checks.txt (the file the CI configuration is generated from)
notiz: The rule says five, the file says three. Nothing failed, nobody was told: the stored rule simply stopped being true.
